original_record.question:
Tom bought a chocolate heart (see the picture) to Mary on her birthday.
<image1>
How many grams did the chocolate weigh, if each square weighs 10 grams?
original_record.subject: combinatorial geometry

inventory.objects: heart polygon, 4 horizontal internal grid lines, 3 vertical internal grid lines

answer_verification.method: area = middle rectangle 4*2 + upper two triangles 2*(2*1/2) + lower triangle 4*2/2 = 14 unit squares; 14*10=140 grams
